correctness.rationale: Chebyshev minimax residual p_m=T_m((κ+1−2λ)/(κ−1))/T_m((κ+1)/(κ−1)) gives x_m=(1−p_m(A))A^{-1}b. Degree one is a positive multiple of b and q2(A)=8((κ+1)I−A)/(κ²+6κ+1) is entrywise nonnegative for Stieltjes A. In dimension two the third-degree approximate-inverse polynomial reduces by Cayley–Hamilton to c0I+c1A, c1=−16/(κ²+14κ+1), with positive eigenvalues and nonnegative off-diagonal. The assigned κ=4 block-diagonal rational 3×3 example has exact x3=(338/365,304248/1140625,−6783/4562500), yet A^{-1}b positive; independently verified. This proves the assigned statement but not its originality.
